Application for Oral Hearing in the Review Petition is rejected.
The acquittal recorded by the Trial Court was challenged by the
complainant  – present  review  petitioner  before  the High  Court.  After
considering the entire material on record the acquittal was affirmed by the
High Court.  The Special Leave Petition arising therefrom, at the instance of
the Review Petitioner, was dismissed after hearing both sides.
